title: Median From a Data Stream
description_md:
Design a structure that supports adding numbers from a stream and querying the
running median after each addition, using two heaps (a max-heap for the lower half, a min-heap for the
upper half) rather than re-sorting every time.

To keep this judge's integer-only comparisons exact (no floating point), return `2 x median` after each
insertion instead of the median itself -- this is always a whole number.

test_cases.explanation: After inserting just 1, the median is 1, so 2*median = 2. After inserting 1 and 2, the numbers seen so far are {1,2} and the median of an even-sized set is the average of the two middle values: (1+2)/2 = 1.5, so 2*median = 3. After inserting 1, 2, and 3, the median of {1,2,3} is the middle value 2, so 2*median = 4.
